goal.original: Bench-evaluate the LTX spatial upscaler as the SeedVR2 successor: does it reconstruct rather than sharpen, does it keep an eye an eye, and does it clear the 16 GB ceiling that killed MPI-506.
goal.summary: The split-radius sweep ran and is NEGATIVE - radius is strength in disguise and r=10 was already optimal. The instrument built to prove that named a control that does work, an EVIDENCE-GATED transfer, which Fabio verdicted as a PARTIAL PASS: veins gone, fabric speckles only partly gone, expressions lost, plus a new face artifact he describes as bad interpolation. Then the real lead landed: the graph HAS a positive prompt and it has been conditioned on '...natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes' on every arm of this card - it has been ASKING for the speckles every downstream dial was built to filter out.

completed: Split-radius sweep DONE and NEGATIVE - r=2..20 on frames 12/40/65. Invention/reconstruction ratio worst at r=2 (0.511), best at r=8-10 (0.345), and every drift-matched STRENGTH twin at r=10 sits at a constant 0.347. Radius is dominated by strength; leave it at 10
Corrected the plan's own wording - 'a lower split radius (coarser high-pass)' describes two opposite operations; raising r widens the band downward, lowering it narrows to the finest detail
Luma-only transfer arm - NEGATIVE. The veins are luma structures, not a red cast

New instrument band_split.py (self-checked, unsharp control passing on all three frames) - splits face tiles by SOURCE high-pass energy, so flat tiles measure INVENTION and detailed tiles measure RECONSTRUCTION

Evidence gate built (radius_sweep.py arm `g`, transfer_clip.py 6th arg `gate`, both self-checked) and rendered full length as FULL_gated132.mp4, drift-matched to FULL_detail100.mp4 and verified against the in-memory arm
Fabio's verdict on the gate - PARTIAL PASS, four separate readings, all recorded in the plan
FOUND: the positive prompt has been an uncontrolled variable under every measurement on this card, and cfg:1 makes the negative prompt inert
pending: THE NEXT ACTION - re-run sigma 0.85 with a NEUTRAL and an EMPTY positive prompt and re-look. Do not tune more downstream filters until the conditioning is clean. ~1 min GPU per arm, shared card, ASK FIRST
Temporally smooth the gate (average over 3-5 frames, or hold it from one) and re-render - the leading hypothesis for Fabio's 'feels like bad interpolation'. Zero GPU
Explain 'expressions were lost' - NOT predicted by the gate's design, since expression is low-frequency and comes from the source untouched in every detail-transfer arm
Ground-truth invented-texture test - now doubly needed as the ONLY independent check on the gate. ~1 min GPU

task_card.title: LTX spatial upscaler - bench evaluation as the SeedVR2 successor

next_action.description: Re-run sigma 0.85 with a NEUTRAL positive prompt and with an EMPTY one, then look at the skin. build_v2v.py has conditioned every arm on "a woman's face in close up, natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes" - it has been ordering the speckles that the radius sweep and the evidence gate were both built to remove downstream. Fix the upstream cause and re-baseline before any more post-processing work. ~1 minute of GPU per arm; the GPU is shared with Fabio, so ask before starting.

key_decisions: THE SPLIT RADIUS IS CLOSED AND NEGATIVE. It is strength in disguise - every drift-matched strength twin scores identically, and lowering the radius is strictly worse (0.511 at r=2 vs 0.347 at r=10). Optimum is r=8-10, which is where the op already sat. Do not re-open it, and do not re-propose 'a coarser high-pass' - that phrasing is backwards and it is what sent this session down the wrong path.

band_split.py MUST NEVER BE USED TO SCORE THE EVIDENCE GATE. The gate is built from per-pixel source high-pass energy and the instrument picks its regions from per-tile source high-pass energy - the same signal. It would flatter the gate no matter what. This is the sixth instrument-honesty trap on this card and the first one caught BEFORE it was quoted. The gate's only honest evidence is Fabio's eyes and the ground-truth test.

The evidence gate suppresses invention WHERE THERE IS NOTHING TO RECONSTRUCT FROM - not invention as such. A hallucination landing on or near a real edge passes through it untouched, which is why Fabio still sees fabric speckles.
SIGMA IS STILL NOT THE CHANGE KNOB (rejected twice, unchanged). The temporal upscaler is STILL closed negative. Neither is re-openable.
The prompt finding outranks every remaining post-processing idea. Do not tune more filters on top of an arm whose conditioning asks for the defect.
constraints: GPU IS SHARED WITH FABIO on one 16 GB card and the 2x spatial arm peaks at ~15.3-15.9 GB. ASK before any sampler run. To yield: kill the runner, POST /interrupt IN A LOOP (ComfyUI only acts at a step boundary), then POST /free {unload_models:true,free_memory:true}.
EVERY LTX frame count must be 8n+1 (1, 9, 17, 25, 33, 49, 81). VHS_LoadVideo hands over 13 and LTX SILENTLY crops to 9 - the output frame count is the only symptom.

There is NO ffmpeg on PATH and no cv2 in the system python. Use C:/AI/Mpi/Cubric-Vision/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe (no ffprobe beside it) and numpy + PIL. The Bash tool BLOCKS heredocs - write python files with the Write tool and run them by path. json.load on board.json needs encoding='utf-8' or it dies on cp1252.
